determinism.rootCause: R1 launched 141576f0... while two clean builds of the same sources gave fc7fc730.... Byte diff: 73 bytes in 8 ranges (PE header TimeDateStamp, the debug-directory and export-directory stamps, the CodeView GUID and age, the IMAGE_DEBUG_TYPE_REPRO hash); .text, .rdata code and .data identical. The CodeView age was 2 in the launched DLL and 1 in the clean pair: an incremental link reuses the PDB left in the build directory and increments its age; the age sits in the image, and /Brepro derives the timestamp, the GUID and the Repro hash from the image contents, so all of them change with it.

r2Implements.H5: kPostLoad / kPostPostLoad / kPostLoadGame / kNewGame forwarded (since 0.3.0); kNewGame and kPostLoadGame also arm the self-test
r2Implements.H6-pickup: PlayerCharacter::PickUpObject (vfunc 0xCC) hooked on the player's own vtable: Rules::CanAccept rebuilds the board from the live inventory and places the copies being picked up; kRefuseNoSlot -> the engine is not called, the reference stays in the world, HUD 'No free slot for <name>', info log 'pickup refused: ...'
r2Implements.H6-container: PlayerCharacter::AddObjectToContainer (vfunc 0x5A): the engine calls it from inside the source's RemoveItem, so an inline refusal would delete the copy; the copy is let in, the refusal is logged, and the reconcile moves it out one frame later
r2Implements.H6-drawn: [Display] ActionEventDrawnState=1 registers SKSE::GetActionEventSource() (kEndDraw / kEndSheathe) beside the graph-tag sink; culling changes log 'culled while drawn' / 'visible again'
r2Implements.reconcile: Rules/Reconcile: TESContainerChangedEvent arrivals on a governed actor and the gate's refusals both schedule a main-thread reconcile; copies of the arriving form with no slot are returned to the source container/actor (unless the BarterMenu is open) else Storage::Deposit; HUD 'No free slot for <name>: returned to <source> | dropped at your feet | stored in <stash>'; never a delete; a save that already overflows is not touched
r2Implements.H10-storage: Rules/Storage: [Storage] StashPlugin + StashFormID resolve a persistent container reference through TESDataHandler::LookupForm; unset or unresolved -> Actor::DropObject at the actor's feet (engine drop, reference logged).
